literal: desired at the time those those are like indeed, petal full of she who has hair shoulder.
translation: Whenever I desire something, the shoulders of my love, whose hair is full of flowers, feel exactly like the very thing I long for.
modern: பூவிதழ்கள் நிறைந்த கூந்தலை உடையவளின் தோள்கள், நான் எதை எதை விரும்புகிறேனோ அந்தந்த நேரங்களில் அந்தந்தப் பொருள்களைப் போலவே எனக்கு இன்பம் தருகின்றன.
explanation: The lover marvels at the joy of embracing his beloved, whose hair is adorned with flower petals. He says that her shoulders have a magical quality of feeling exactly like whatever he desires at any given moment. The repetition of the word 'அவை' (those respective things) emphasizes that her embrace is infinitely adaptable, perfectly fulfilling every specific longing he experiences.
